title: Production Learning & Autonomous Roadmap Renewal III
purpose: Close the 377–389 capability review with a bounded Production evidence-availability snapshot, without declaring unobserved outcomes successful. Redirect the next wave to real, safe first-use workflows.

review_basis.scope: Read-only grouped SQL aggregate over ten named public operational tables in the existing YW Supabase Production project on 2026-10-13; no row payloads, identities, contacts, device identifiers or private notes were retrieved. This is a one-time created_at-ingestion snapshot, not an immutable historical forecast or live management dashboard.
review_basis.limitations: The ten sampled tables are not the complete database, and created_at counts are not service outcomes. Zero sampled rows establishes no evidence in these inspected sources on this inspection, NOT zero business activity everywhere. Views and external devices may contain additional facts; do not infer a company-wide absence of operations.
review_basis.privacy: Only aggregate counts and null latest-created timestamps recorded; no tenant, employee, customer or job identifiers.
review_basis.denominator_boundary: Minimum-five distinct source keys or unambiguous completed pairs in each required window; missing/capped/stale/hidden/unknown timestamps withhold comparative rates; no percentage based on a zero denominator.

production_source_snapshot.measurement: aggregated row presence by created_at, latest 30 days and preceding 60 days, in the inspected public table
production_source_snapshot.warning: This is a dated snapshot only. Never substitute it for a real-time query or conflate absent sample data with successful source operations.

renewal_strategy: Prioritize functioning guided operator paths and truthful first-use data collection before another round of trend-only dashboards.
Keep spring/summer landscaping, fall cleanup/leaf, winter snow/storm/ice and general four-season workflows in one system.
Honor Jobs, Safety, Equipment, HR, CRM and Finance authority and user confirmations at every write boundary; renewals and billing are never automatic.
Use the actual canonical database and current source permission/freshness/coverage checks; no synthetic Production records or inferred success.
Require visible pending/saved/error acknowledgement for consequential user actions, idempotency and safe offline conflict resolution.
Each item remains independently testable with repository fixtures and browser checks; no real payment, messaging, provider credentials, remote staging approval or user signoff for ordinary CI.
Never treat protected-main GitHub checks or Vercel READY as proof a changed Supabase Edge Function was updated; inspect and deploy exact source when a backend changes.
Hold improvement, conversion-rate or cohort claims until sufficient date-stamped Production evidence is present and source quality is demonstrably current.

renewed_queue.title: First-Use Readiness & Verified Data Intake
renewed_queue.source_authority: profiles, source-freshness, customer/property, Jobs and Production views
renewed_queue.acceptance: Show an operator-facing first-use checklist driven by actual empty/nonempty canonical data and explicit module access. Recheck reads without fabricated sample rows; no writes.
renewed_queue.safety_boundary: Read-only readiness first; no auto-creation, default business seed or write bypass.
renewed_queue.prerequisite: Existing mainline production-authorized read paths and repository-owned tests

renewed_queue.title: Customer & Property Guided Record Creation
renewed_queue.acceptance: Reuse authorized CRM customer/property forms and existing duplicate warnings; verify one save, edit, lookup and permission-denied browser flow against exact existing write authority, without automatic import.
renewed_queue.safety_boundary: Any create/edit must use existing authorized forms; no duplicate customer creation or external contact.
renewed_queue.prerequisite: Verified predecessor item 391; existing owner/module permissions

renewed_queue.title: Four-Season Service Template & Price Source Validation
renewed_queue.source_authority: service catalog, templates, season and tax configuration
renewed_queue.acceptance: Expose season/service-specific existing price and unit source validation, missing-rate warnings and Canadian tax context; do not invent rates or publish prices.
renewed_queue.safety_boundary: Configuration review only; no live price change or invoice write.
renewed_queue.prerequisite: Verified predecessor item 392; existing owner/module permissions

renewed_queue.title: Crew Availability & Dispatch Conflict Gate
renewed_queue.acceptance: Test job assignment against actual crew availability, overlapping dispatch, ready vehicles and configured schedules using the existing Jobs authority, no auto-rescheduling.
renewed_queue.safety_boundary: No automatic route editing, personnel reassignment or dispatch.
renewed_queue.prerequisite: Verified predecessor item 393; existing owner/module permissions

renewed_queue.title: Workability Safe Schedule Recheck
renewed_queue.acceptance: Require recorded Ontario conditions, workability decisions and Safety permission for schedule-review readiness, never override a hold or automatically dispatch.
renewed_queue.safety_boundary: Safety and operator workability decision remain final; no autonomous scheduling.
renewed_queue.prerequisite: Verified predecessor item 394; existing owner/module permissions

renewed_queue.title: Job Start/Stop & Production Evidence Capture

renewed_queue.acceptance: Make one mobile job session path legible with a pending/saved/retry/error acknowledgement and linked completion evidence; no duplicate sessions on repeated clicks.
